source.author: verg
source.text: Aut si quam ferro mactaverat ante sacerdos inde neque impositis ardent altaria fibris nec responsa potest consultus reddere vates, ac vix suppositi tinguntur sanguine cultri summaque ieiuna sanie infuscatur harena.
source.text_original: Aut si quam ferro mactaverat ante sacerdos / inde neque impositis ardent altaria fibris / nec responsa potest consultus reddere vates, / ac vix suppositi tinguntur sanguine cultri / summaque ieiuna sanie infuscatur harena.
source.text_english: Or if some beast the priest has already slain with the sword, then neither do the altars burn with the entrails laid upon them, nor can the seer consulted give any responses; and scarcely are the knives, placed beneath, stained with blood, and the topmost sand is darkened with the fasting gore.

reuse.author: lact
reuse.text: nam cum diis suis immolant, si assistat aliquis signatam frontem gerens, sacra nullo modo litant nec responsa potest consultus reddere uates .
reuse.text_original: nam cum diis suis immolant, si assistat aliquis signatam frontem gerens, sacra nullo modo litant nec responsa potest consultus reddere uates .
reuse.text_english: for when they sacrifice to their gods, if anyone is present wearing a marked forehead, the rites by no means obtain favorable omens, nor can the prophet, when consulted, give responses.
